behaviors.description: Binding-authenticated Principal identity is checked against Actor, Endpoint, and Delegation claims.
assertions: Client payload cannot self-authenticate a Principal.
Authority is revalidated for every state mutation.

behaviors.description: Endpoints register discoverable protocol versions, bindings, capabilities, leases, and limits.
assertions: Discovery does not expose credentials or executable implementation.
Matching and scheduling algorithms are not prescribed.

behaviors.description: A valid offer creates an authoritative Handoff in offered state.
assertions: Exactly one target form is present.
Initiator retains responsibility until acceptance.

behaviors.description: A Capability-targeted Handoff remains pending until an authorized external Resolver submits one eligible Actor or Endpoint, or transparently reports that no target is available.
assertions: The immutable Capability Requirement and separate Target Binding are both retained.
Core validates one explicit target but never selects, ranks, or schedules candidates.
Concurrent resolutions commit at most one authoritative binding.
Unavailable eligibility verification fails closed without persistence.

behaviors.description: An authorized Recipient accepts responsibility for an offered or rework-requested Handoff.
assertions: State becomes accepted.
A responsibility_accepted Receipt and accepted event are recorded.

behaviors.description: A Recipient can decline an offered Handoff without accepting responsibility.
assertions: State becomes declined.
Declined is terminal.

behaviors.description: An unaccepted Handoff expires only after its acceptance deadline.
assertions: accept_by has elapsed.
State becomes expired and cannot be mutated.

behaviors.description: Policy-authorized cancellation ends an offered or accepted Handoff.
assertions: State becomes cancelled.
External side effects are not implicitly compensated.

behaviors.description: A Recipient publishes transparent external execution status.
assertions: Lifecycle state remains accepted.
Progress is informational and never a transition condition.

behaviors.description: A Recipient returns structured summary, artifacts, and evidence.
assertions: State becomes result_returned.
Exchange validates schema and authority but not professional correctness.

behaviors.description: The designated Verifier evaluates returned results against acceptance criteria.
assertions: Verification precedes close.
Verified and closed events preserve resource ordering.

behaviors.description: The Verifier can request rework and the original Recipient explicitly reaccepts responsibility.
assertions: State becomes rework_requested before reacceptance.
Reacceptance returns state to accepted.

behaviors.description: Transfer creates a child offered Handoff while the parent remains accepted.
assertions: Parent remains accepted until child acceptance.
Child acceptance atomically marks parent transferred.

behaviors.description: Durable subscriptions receive at-least-once CloudEvent deliveries and acknowledge delivery separately.
assertions: Consumers deduplicate by CloudEvent id.
Delivery Ack never accepts Handoff responsibility.

behaviors.description: State-changing commands are idempotent and use optimistic resource versions.
assertions: Same key and payload replay the prior result.
Same key with different payload returns idempotency_key_reused.
Version mismatch returns version_conflict.
